name: moottwins
title: moottwins
blurb: hashes every one of a handle's mutuals' avatar photos (skipping solid-color and stock icon pfps), pairs up whoever came out visually closest, and writes a rhyming mnemonic for each pair — a line pulled from bio or recent posts that disambiguates the actual people when there is one, pfp color/brightness/etc. when there isn't. also flags mutuals whose display names alone are easy to mix up. asked for by @thebadcode.com, who kept mixing up mutuals with similar pfps.
